scenarios.title: Trusted source to read action
scenarios.description: A trusted source reaching a read action resolves to allow through rule TW-001.
scenarios.rationale: The agent's normal working path. A policy that denies this blocks all legitimate work, so this case is the control that detects an over-restrictive policy.

scenarios.title: Trusted source to write action
scenarios.description: A trusted source reaching a write action resolves to deny through the default decision.
scenarios.rationale: Source trust alone does not grant write access. A write path must be declared by an explicit rule.

scenarios.title: Trusted source to sensitive action
scenarios.description: A trusted source reaching a sensitive action resolves to deny through the default decision.
scenarios.rationale: Sensitive record access is never implied by a trusted source; it requires its own rule.

scenarios.title: Trusted source to external action
scenarios.description: A trusted source reaching a external action resolves to deny through the default decision.
scenarios.rationale: An outbound action is never authorized by source trust alone, even for a first-party request.

scenarios.title: Conditional source to read action
scenarios.description: A conditional source reaching a read action resolves to deny through the default decision.
scenarios.rationale: Conditionally trusted context carries no declared read grant, so the default decision applies.

scenarios.title: Conditional source to write action
scenarios.description: A conditional source reaching a write action resolves to deny through the default decision.
scenarios.rationale: No declared write grant exists for conditional sources; the flow fails closed.

scenarios.title: Conditional source to sensitive action
scenarios.description: A conditional source reaching a sensitive action resolves to deny through rule TW-003.
scenarios.rationale: Conditionally trusted content must not reach sensitive records without human review.

scenarios.title: Conditional source to external action
scenarios.description: A conditional source reaching a external action resolves to require_approval through rule TW-002.
scenarios.rationale: Confidential context may influence an outbound action only behind a bound human approval.

scenarios.title: Untrusted source to read action
scenarios.description: A untrusted source reaching a read action resolves to deny through the default decision.
scenarios.rationale: Untrusted input has no declared grant, including for reads.

scenarios.title: Untrusted source to write action
scenarios.description: A untrusted source reaching a write action resolves to deny through the default decision.
scenarios.rationale: Untrusted input must never reach a write path.

scenarios.title: Untrusted source to sensitive action
scenarios.description: A untrusted source reaching a sensitive action resolves to deny through rule TW-003.
scenarios.rationale: Retrieved or third-party content must not directly authorize sensitive record access.

scenarios.title: Untrusted source to external action
scenarios.description: A untrusted source reaching a external action resolves to deny through rule TW-004.
scenarios.rationale: Untrusted content must not directly cause an outbound action.
